label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly to sendRedirect URL path without sanitization. Host regex validates domain (.safe.com suffix) but does not protect against path traversal in 'seg'. Resolved sink value: https://{host}/{seg} where seg = request.getParameter('seg') or 'home', allowing attacker to inject path components like ../../../etc/passwd or %2e%2e%2f sequences.

evidence.note: User-controlled 'seg' parameter assigned to variable, then concatenated into redirect URL without path validation
